scripts.dev: trap 'docker compose stop' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT TERM; docker compose up -d --wait && npm exec --workspace playground -- nuxvel db:migrate && npm run dev --workspace playground
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/nuxt --workspace packages/cli --workspace packages/create
scripts.deps:upgrade: npm update && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/nuxt --workspace packages/cli --workspace packages/create --workspace packages/test-helpers --workspace playground
